title: SekaiCTF 2024
description:
SekaiCTF is back for its third iteration! This year’s competition will feature various categories designed to test participants’ skills and incentivize learning. Our CTF will have more difficult challenges, and are catered towards intermediate and advanced players—however, there will still be beginner-friendly challenges to welcome players on the newer side.

Join the Discord to learn more: https://discord.gg/6gk7jhCgGX

[+] Categories
・Web, Cryptography, Pwn, Reverse Engineering, Miscellaneous, Blockchain, and Programming (PPC)

[+] Prize Pool
・USD$3,000 cash and prizes valued over $10,000
・The Winner of SekaiCTF 2024 will qualify for the 9th XCTF Finals in China: https://adworld.xctf.org.cn/

[+] Sponsors
・OtterSec (https://osec.io/)

・XCTF League (https://adworld.xctf.org.cn/)
